about: P64 T8-R7 third sealed portrait set: 24 English sentences written and sealed 30. 10. 2026 after the slice fix (T8-R5) and the merge of origin/main with P66 and P67, before anything is shot on them. The second set (../r3/holdout.json) was opened in T8-R3 and the code changed after it. s64-01 to s64-19 = one sentence per genre that P64 frames (GENRES of src/play/genre/contract.ts without the P66 genres), in that order; s64-20 to s64-24 = five more board-genre sentences: two slice (the genre that lost in every earlier judgement), timing stack, catch and merge. genre = what the quick game's offline classifier picks today (classifyGenre(text, null).ranked[0].genre, no model call). The no-model draft (draftGameSpecWithMeta, seed 1) plays that genre for 20 of 24 when sealed; s64-07 drafts quest and s64-18, s64-19, s64-24 draft arena, the same as every merge and push sentence of r3 and board-dev on main 0da52829, so both sides share it. Opened once (r4/holdout-opened.json); nothing is tuned on it.

sentences.text: A mail carrier sprints down a snowy mountain road dodging rolling barrels and stray goats
A clockwork mouse jumps across crumbling ledges above a flooded sewer
A sheepdog chases runaway lambs around a muddy farmyard all afternoon
A paper airplane glides over a busy harbor, weaving past ship masts and seagulls
A gardener waters every wilted flower bed across a royal palace garden before the queen wakes
A space cowboy blasts giant worms swarming around a desert outpost
A grandma tosses snowballs at sneaky squirrels raiding her bird feeder
A window cleaner stacks paint buckets onto a swaying scaffold without letting it topple
A beach drummer pounds the bongos to the beat at a sunset party
A young fencer faces the champion in a final duel under a stadium spotlight
A hummingbird flutters up through a jungle waterfall dodging hanging vines
A baker catches donuts falling from a broken oven chute in a paper bag
A plumber bonks rubber ducks popping out of bathtub drains in an old hotel
A scarecrow defends the cornfield from waves of hungry crows at dusk
A sword master slices flying melons tossed over a bamboo garden wall
A duckling crosses a busy harbor road full of forklifts to reach the pond
A marching band grows by passing through magic gates along a parade street
A jeweler combines matching pearls into bigger pearls on a velvet tray
Two penguins shove each other out of an icy sumo ring on a frozen lake

A circus clown stacks wobbly cakes onto a tall wedding tower without letting it topple
